messages:
elaine: Heads-up — found a cluster of zero-dollar invoices in the AR export for a handful of enterprise prepay customers. Usage tokens present but amount = 0. Noticed in yesterday's job.

tom: Ugh. Do you have example invoice IDs? Can you paste a row?

elaine: Example rows: invoice_id=INV-3421983 customer=acme-corp usage_tokens=1234567 amount=0 currency=USD. Also INV-3422010 and INV-3422055. Export pulled from `reports/ar_export_2025-12-31.csv`.

anika: Possible mapping bug between our usage bucketing and the pricing experiment flags. We rolled out a new promo mapping on 12/29. Could be zeroing price when promo flag present.

leo: I ran a quick grep on yesterday's billing pipeline logs — saw this warning twice: `WARN pricing: missing_price_for_tier promo_flag=beta-q4 customer_tier=enterprise`. Might align.

acct-bot: Automated note — created billing-issue ticket #BILL-8765 for invoices INV-3421983, INV-3422010, INV-3422055.

tom: Thanks. Action plan: (1) stop auto-finalizing affected invoices (put them back to draft), (2) run price-lookup on those invoice rows with the old mapping, (3) hold any collections. Who can revert the mapping?

anika: I can revert the promo mapping to previous commit `git rev-parse HEAD~1` and re-run price calc for those customers. Will need a quick sanity check from finance before pushing.

elaine: Please do revert to the commit from 12/28. Send me the diff and I'll check the top 5 affected accounts.

leo: I'll prepare a mini-reconciliation: compare `ar_export` vs `billing_calc` outputs and list mismatches. Command I used: `python tools/compare_ar.py --csv reports/ar_export_2025-12-31.csv --run billing_calc_20251231.json --filter amount==0` — spits the invoice rows.

tom: Great. If revert fixes it, we need a journal entry for the previously booked zero-revenue invoices. @elaine can you coordinate JE with accounting?

elaine: Yes — if amounts change we'll need a reversing entry and recognition to the correct period. I'll prepare a draft JE and post here.

anika: Revert scheduled at 14:00 PT. I'll take a DB snapshot before applying.

leo: I'll run the comparison pre/post and attach the CSV. Will also run `select count(1) from invoices where amount = 0 and invoice_date >= '2025-12-01' and source = 'billing_pipeline';` to get scope.

tom: FYI we should also flag any customer-facing notifications; but hold until we know scope. No emails for now.

elaine: Summarizing action items: 1) anika revert mapping at 14:00 PT with snapshot, 2) leo run pre/post reconciliation and attach CSV, 3) elaine draft JE if amounts change, 4) tom freeze finalization/collections for the affected invoices. Tag me when done, I'll escalate to revenue ops if larger than $50k.

anika: Revert applied and smoke-tested. Diff: -promo_map['enterprise']['tierX'] = 0 -> +promo_map['enterprise']['tierX'] = 0.015. (pushed to `staging` then `billing-runner` exec).

leo: Pre/post comparison attached — 3 invoices updated from 0 -> nonzero, total delta $38,742. INV-3421983=+28,250, INV-3422010=+6,192, INV-3422055=+4,300.

elaine: Delta under $50k. I'll prepare JE and won't escalate. tom please reopen finalization and resume collections on those invoices after JE posted.

tom: Will do. Also adding a postmortem checklist item to test that promo mapping change has a staging billing run and zero-dollar assertion check.

acct-bot: Ticket BILL-8765 updated: status=resolved resolution="mapping revert + JE".

elaine: Thanks team. Closing here once JE is in GL.
